name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>. '30' is the chapter ID (chapters 01-30 are meaningful domain IDs, must be preserved per domain knowledge; not Ghidra address residue). 'init' = chapter init handler dispatched from data_fd2_chapter_init_handler_table (xref @0x51de5 = LE dword 0x00033e3c, the dispatch table entry). Name accurately reflects purpose; no address residue.
purpose: Chapter 30 (final chapter, 傳說的終章-結局) init/prologue handler: cinematically warps the 魔神 (demon-god) group onto the battle map in two staged batches separated by a white palette flash, plays three dialog pages, then hands off the final battle.
logic_summary: void handler dispatched from the chapter-init table. Re-inits battle state; cutscene event 0x57; pans camera/window (0x10,0x13); dialog page 0; battle_anim_phase=0; pans (0x10,1); batch-1 warp-in of 4 demon-gods to top row tile_y=5 (char ids 0x15/0x16/0x17/0x18 at tile_x 0x15/0x17/0x14/0x18); dialog page 1; white palette flash pulse; dialog page 2; battle_anim_phase=0; pans (0x10,0xe); batch-2 warp-in of 3 demon-gods to bottom row tile_y=0x12 (char ids 0x18/0x19/0x1a at tile_x 0x16/0x15/0x17); battle_anim_phase=1; clear all facings; pan camera to char 0. Total 7 fd2_cinematic_warp_char_to_tile(char_id, tile_x, tile_y) calls. In the binary the trailing clear-facing + pan-to-char are a tail-JMP into the shared epilogue owned by fd2_chapter_05_init; src is the Layer-2 straight-line equivalent.

returns.semantics: No return value; side-effect-only cutscene/warp orchestration. The leading __CHK(0x28) is the Watcom frame-size stack probe, not part of the source body.
